decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (SAL/WH/KESS/1016/001, LSS-DWX-WHC-TOPO-001 A1, SO-751-01 Rev C, SO-751-02 Rev A, SO-751-03 Rev A, SO-751-04 Rev A, SO-751-05 Rev A, WH/RM/001, Design & Access Statement (dated: 11/2016), Schedule of Works, Drainworx Preliminary Site Visit Report (dated: 13/10/2016), ICR Drainage Solution (dated: 19/10/2009), Disaster Care Platinum Claim Report, Received: 28/11/2016. Savills Additional Information (dated: 04/03/2017), Received: 29/03/2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
